content.text: {"reachable": true, "rationale": "The only deployed defence is patched_appserver, so every other defence constant stays false. One path to exfiltration: (1) exploit_web gives foothold_web, since patched_web is false. (2) pivot_internal gives reach_internal, since there is a foothold and segmented is false. (3) phish_workstation gives foothold_workstation and stolen_user. (4) auth_appserver gives foothold_appserver: reach_internal and stolen_user hold, and mfa_user is false. (5) kerberoast_dc gives stolen_admin, since reach_internal and foothold_appserver hold. (6) auth_dc gives foothold_dc, since reach_internal and stolen_admin hold and mfa_admin is false. (7) escalate_dc gives admin_dc. (8) dump_dbadmin_dc gives stolen_dbadmin. (9) auth_db gives foothold_db: reach_internal and stolen_dbadmin hold, and mfa_dbadmin is false. (10) escalate_db gives admin_db. (11) exfiltrate_db sets exfiltrated. Patching the appserver blocks only the unpatched route of escalate_appserver, which this path never uses."}
